title: Neural Message Passing for Quantum Chemistry
layout_note: An input molecule at the left forks into two paths, a slow 'DFT' box on top and a wide 'Message Passing Neural Net' box below, which both reach a shared 'Targets' box at top right.
grouping: No containers beyond the boxes themselves: two parallel routes (top DFT, bottom MPNN) from one input circle to one output box; each route carries its run-time annotation directly under its box.
shapes_depth: Flat mid-grey rectangles with thick black outlines and a grey circle for the input; no rounding, shadows or 3-D. The input molecule is a white skeletal line drawing inside the circle. Inside the MPNN box the molecule is drawn three times as a ball-and-stick graph whose node dots are white, blue, red and purple, joined by small white arrows. Large serif math labels: 'E, ω0, ...' in Targets and '~10^3 seconds' / '~10^-2 seconds' under the boxes.
proposed_highlight: The MPNN box is the widest box and the only one with internal content (three message-passing snapshots); the contrast with DFT is carried by the two run-time annotations, not by colour.
lesson: Put the proposed model and the expensive baseline on parallel paths from the same input to the same target and print each path's cost under its box, so the speed-up reads at a glance.
notes: Venue and year from the first page (Proceedings of the 34th ICML, PMLR 70, 2017). This is the paper's only figure; it is a teaser that also shows the message-passing state changing over steps. elements 'callout' = the run-time annotations.

arrangement.units: two horizontal lanes without frames: top lane a single 'DFT' box, bottom lane the 'Message Passing Neural Net' box holding three graph snapshots; both converge on a 'Targets' box at top right
arrangement.inputs_as: a grey circle holding a white skeletal drawing of the molecule
arrangement.losses_at: none drawn; the 'Targets' box (E, ω0, ...) is the shared output
arrangement.shared: the input circle and the Targets box are shared by both lanes

core.what: one molecule in a circle forks into two routes to the same Targets box - a small DFT box above (~10^3 seconds) and a wide Message Passing Neural Net box below (~10^-2 seconds) - so the cost contrast reads as two parallel paths

relations.form: arrows leave the input circle and fork up into DFT and down into the MPNN box; both end at the Targets box (E, omega_0, ...) at the top right, the DFT path straight across and the MPNN path turning up from below
inside the MPNN box three ball-and-stick copies of the molecular graph, joined by white arrows, show node dots changing colour (white, blue, red, purple) as messages pass

channels.colour: node-dot colour = node state at each message-passing snapshot; all boxes share one grey fill
channels.shape: circle = the input molecule; rectangles = methods or targets; ball-and-stick graphs = the molecular graph
channels.line: solid black arrows = computation routes; white arrows = message-passing steps
channels.frame: grey box = one route or the target set

quality.strengths: the claim (MPNN replaces DFT at a fraction of the cost) is drawn as two routes from one input to one output with the runtimes in large type under each; message passing is shown on the actual molecular graph, with node states changing colour step by step
quality.weaknesses: every box shares the same grey fill, so input, method and output are told apart only by shape and text; the node colours are unexplained and their meaning must be guessed; the MPNN path makes a right-angle turn up into Targets instead of meeting it head on

insights.structure: A grey input circle on the left forks into two parallel grey boxes, a small 'DFT' box on top and a wide 'Message Passing Neural Net' box below, which both feed one 'Targets' box at top right.
insights.data: The molecule is a white skeletal drawing in the input circle and, inside the MPNN box, three ball-and-stick graphs whose node dots change colour (white, blue, red, purple) from snapshot to snapshot.
insights.emphasis: Large serif annotations '~10^3 seconds' and '~10^-2 seconds' under the two routes make the cost contrast the message, and the MPNN box is the only one with content inside.
insights.flow: Arrows leave the input circle right and fork up and down, the DFT path runs straight into Targets, and the MPNN path turns upward into Targets from below.
insights.avoid: All boxes share the same flat mid-grey fill, so the proposed net is not set apart from the DFT baseline by colour, and the node colours inside the snapshots have no key.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
